fit.status: v6 audited global replay with conservative association pooling
fit.selection: The association share is reduced from 0.65 to 0.35 so an elite continental participant's result remains primarily club-specific instead of being assigned twice across its domestic league. The confederation bridge is identified against the evidence-weighted 90th-percentile association because global tournaments select leading clubs. Score normalization, Club World Cup classification and metadata finalization are also corrected. Full replay metrics are regenerated with every installation.

method.rating: 1500 + club residual + tier + association coefficient + confederation coefficient - uncertainty penalty
method.home: Separate fitted domestic and cross-border home advantages; neutral matches receive zero.
method.same_date: Every match on a date is forecast from one frozen start-of-day state, then that date is updated.
method.aggregate: Only a controlled second-leg loss by a club that remains ahead on aggregate is discounted; comebacks, level ties, and confirming wins retain full weight.
